fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) has a 24/7 Wall St. price target of $795.28, presenting 35.3% upside from the current price of $587.84, with a buy rating maintained.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue increased 26% year-over-year to $64.6B, but GAAP EPS of $3.83 missed expectations of $5.70 due to a one-time $98.9B legal settlement charge, with AI new business revenue contribution expected in 2027.
fields.summary_ko.2: AI assistant Muse acquired 10 million users in the U.S. and Canada over 6 weeks, with 25% daily active usage rate and average purchase amount exceeding $200.
